points.quote: The Incomappleux FSR was closed under FRPA Section 22.2(3), with the intent to deactivate it as there is no funding to do repairs or maintenance, and there is no future industrial access need.
The road has been closed and gated since 2017, and the roads in the valley are overgrown and not safe for travel.
